checks.statement: If the stated action homomorphism is onto Aut(omega(X)) and omega(X) has two elements, its kernel has index 2.
checks.reasoning: A two-element set has exactly two permutations. Kernel cosets correspond bijectively to the image of a homomorphism. Under the stated surjectivity, there are two cosets.
